description: MEASURED pair-feature columns flipped by the Wf-A94/A95 donor-set extensions on the canonical 5-metal MetalCytoTox cohort. Counts every i<j pair within the head's 3.5 A edge cutoff where exactly one endpoint is a project metal and the other is in the added element set.
interpretation: The organic extension is feature-side only: 1,540 pair-feature columns flip (0.26% of pairs, 77% of clouds) and 0 builder-written bond labels change, because the builder ranks no organic element. Carbon accounts for 1,539 of the 1,540; B/Si/As add exactly 1 pair. Halides add 8. Any pre-A95 checkpoint would see a different is_dative column on 77% of clouds, which is why the feature_schema stamp exists.
